data: # Unset all aliases to avoid conflicts with functions

shopt -u compat40

shopt -u globstar

shopt -u histreedit
shopt -u histverify
shopt -s hostcomplete
shopt -u huponexit
shopt -u inherit_errexit
shopt -s interactive_comments

shopt -u lithist
shopt -u localvar_inherit

shopt -s login_shell
shopt -u mailwarn
shopt -u no_empty_cmd_completion
shopt -u nocaseglob
shopt -u nocasematch
shopt -u noexpand_translation

# Functions

# setopts 3
set -o braceexpand
set -o hashall
set -o interactive-comments
